metadata.title: कॉनराड संगमा इंटरव्यू | Exclusive Interview with Conrad Kongkal Sangma
metadata.description:
Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad Sangma, in an exclusive interview with Chitrita Sanyal, Editor of Main Bhi Bharat, claimed that Meghalaya is the only state in India to allocate 8% of its budget to the health sector. He highlighted the government's commitment to improving healthcare infrastructure, accessibility, and services across the state.

During the conversation, CM Sangma also addressed the recent Meghalaya Land Transfer Act amendment. He explained the reasons behind this crucial change and how it aims to protect the interests of indigenous communities while facilitating economic growth and investment in the state.

From health policies to land reforms, this insightful discussion sheds light on Meghalaya's governance priorities and development vision. Watch this exclusive interview for an in-depth understanding of the state's key policy decisions and their impact on the people.

Stay tuned to Main Bhi Bharat for more such exclusive stories!
